data.name: Haleef
data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Haleef means 'The Protector'. This name is derived from the Arabic word 'halafa', which means 'to protect, defend or shield'. In Islamic history, the name Haleef is associated with righteous and noble individuals, such as Haleef bin Harith, a companion of Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) and the father of Imam Ali Zainul Abideen (as).
